name: Elon Musk
line: Elon Musk is the chief executive officer of Tesla and SpaceX and the owner of X. He oversees aerospace engineering, electric vehicle manufacturing, and satellite communications infrastructure.

name: Mark Zuckerberg
line: Mark Zuckerberg is the founder, chairman, and chief executive officer of Meta Platforms. He directs development across social networking platforms, virtual reality hardware, and artificial intelligence technologies.

name: Sam Altman
line: Sam Altman is the chief executive officer of OpenAI and former president of the startup accelerator Y Combinator. He directs the development and commercial deployment of artificial intelligence models.

name: Jensen Huang
line: Jensen Huang is the co-founder, president, and chief executive officer of Nvidia. He leads the design and manufacturing of graphics processing units and specialized computing hardware for artificial intelligence.

name: Satya Nadella
line: Satya Nadella is the chairman and chief executive officer of Microsoft. He oversees enterprise software development, cloud computing services, personal computing hardware, and artificial intelligence partnerships.

name: Sundar Pichai
line: Sundar Pichai is the chief executive officer of Alphabet and its subsidiary Google. He manages internet services, search engine development, mobile operating systems, and enterprise cloud operations.

name: Bob Iger
line: Bob Iger is the chief executive officer of The Walt Disney Company. He oversaw corporate acquisitions of Pixar, Marvel Entertainment, and Lucasfilm, as well as the launch of the company's streaming media services.

name: Alex Hormozi
line: Alex Hormozi is an entrepreneur, investor, and author who co-founded Acquisition.com. He invests in private small businesses and produces instructional materials on business operations and sales strategy.

name: Alex Karp
line: Alex Karp is the co-founder and chief executive officer of Palantir Technologies. He directs the development of data integration and analytics software platforms for government intelligence agencies and commercial enterprises.

name: Palmer Luckey
line: Palmer Luckey is the founder of defense technology contractor Anduril Industries and the co-founder of Oculus VR. He develops autonomous defense systems, sensor hardware, and virtual reality displays.

name: Chamath Palihapitiya
line: Chamath Palihapitiya is a venture capitalist and the founder and chief executive officer of Social Capital. He invests in technology enterprises, sponsors special purpose acquisition companies, and co-hosts the All-In podcast.

name: Jeff Bezos
line: Jeff Bezos is the founder and executive chair of Amazon, the founder of aerospace manufacturer Blue Origin, and the owner of The Washington Post. He works across e-commerce logistics, cloud infrastructure, and spaceflight.

name: Bill Gates
line: Bill Gates is the co-founder of Microsoft and co-chair of the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. He focuses on global philanthropy, directing initiatives in public health, disease eradication, and agricultural research.

name: Oprah Winfrey
line: Oprah Winfrey is a media executive and the founder of Harpo Productions and the Oprah Winfrey Network. She hosted a syndicated talk show and produces television programs, films, and publications.

name: Dana White
line: Dana White is the chief executive officer and president of the Ultimate Fighting Championship. He oversees promotional operations, athlete contracting, and event broadcasting for mixed martial arts competitions.

name: Kris Jenner
line: Kris Jenner is a talent manager, television producer, and businesswoman. She manages the commercial partnerships, brand licensing, and media production ventures of her family members.

name: Richard Branson
line: Richard Branson is the founder of the Virgin Group. He has established commercial ventures across aviation, telecommunications, music retail, passenger rail, and commercial spaceflight.

name: Larry Ellison
line: Larry Ellison is the co-founder, executive chairman, and chief technology officer of Oracle Corporation. He directs enterprise database software development, cloud infrastructure architecture, and corporate acquisitions.

name: Gary Vaynerchuk
line: Gary Vaynerchuk is the chairman of VaynerX and the chief executive officer of advertising agency VaynerMedia. He operates marketing agencies, invests in consumer startups, and authors books on digital marketing strategy.

name: Jerry Jones
line: Jerry Jones is the owner, president, and general manager of the Dallas Cowboys football franchise. He oversees franchise operations, sports venue management, and commercial real estate development.

name: Demis Hassabis
line: Co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, an artificial intelligence research laboratory. He led the development of AlphaGo and AlphaFold, earning the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structure prediction.

name: Steven Bartlett
line: Co-founder of the social media marketing agency Social Chain and host of the podcast The Diary of a CEO. He serves as an investor on the television series Dragons' Den.

name: Vitalik Buterin
line: Co-founder of Ethereum, a decentralized blockchain platform supporting smart contracts and decentralized applications. He co-founded Bitcoin Magazine and writes on cryptocurrency governance and software development.

name: Michael Saylor
line: Co-founder and executive chairman of MicroStrategy, a business intelligence software company. He directed the firm's corporate treasury strategy into Bitcoin acquisition and advocates for cryptocurrency adoption in corporate finance.

name: Bryan Johnson
line: Founder of payment processor Braintree and neurotechnology company Kernel. He established Project Blueprint, a health protocol examining human longevity through biomedical monitoring.

name: Grant Cardone
line: Real estate investor, sales trainer, and founder of Cardone Capital. He authored books on sales strategy, hosts real estate conferences, and manages commercial and multifamily property portfolios.

name: Rich Paul
line: Sports agent and founder of Klutch Sports Group, representing athletes across professional basketball and American football. He serves on the board of directors of United Talent Agency.

name: Flavio Briatore
line: Italian businessman who managed the Benetton and Renault Formula One teams, securing World Constructors' Championships with both organizations. He also founded the hospitality and entertainment company Billionaire Life.

name: Codie Sanchez
line: Founder and CEO of Contrarian Thinking, a financial media and investment firm focused on small businesses. She previously worked in private equity and asset management, specializing in institutional Latin American investments.

name: Scott Boras
line: Sports agent and founder of the Boras Corporation, representing professional baseball players in Major League Baseball. He negotiates player contracts and arbitration cases with league franchises.

name: Tim Cook
line: Chief executive officer of Apple Inc., having previously served as the company's chief operating officer. He oversees the development, manufacturing, and global distribution of consumer electronics, operating systems, and digital services.

name: Steve Ballmer
line: Owner of the Los Angeles Clippers basketball team and former chief executive officer of Microsoft. He led Microsoft through the expansion of its enterprise software, server products, and gaming divisions.

name: Adam Silver
line: Commissioner of the National Basketball Association, having previously served as deputy commissioner and chief operating officer. He oversees league business operations, collective bargaining agreements, and international media distribution.

name: Steve Cohen
line: Owner of the New York Mets baseball team and founder of hedge fund Point72 Asset Management. He previously founded SAC Capital Advisors and operates across institutional asset management and sports governance.

name: Rob Manfred
line: Commissioner of Major League Baseball, having previously served as the league's chief operating officer and executive vice president. He oversees professional baseball administration, labor negotiations, and rule modifications.

name: Warren Buffett
line: Chairman and chief executive officer of Berkshire Hathaway, a multinational holding company. He directs capital allocation across insurance, energy, and railroad subsidiaries, and co-founded the Giving Pledge philanthropic initiative.

name: Joe Rogan
line: Stand-up comedian, color commentator for the Ultimate Fighting Championship, and host of the podcast The Joe Rogan Experience. He performs touring comedy and founded the Comedy Mothership comedy club.

name: Theo Von
line: Stand-up comedian, television personality, and host of the podcast This Past Weekend. He performs touring stand-up comedy specials and previously co-hosted the podcast The King and the Sting.

name: Shane Gillis
line: Stand-up comedian, actor, and co-host of Matt and Shane's Secret Podcast. He created and starred in the comedy series Tires and performs stand-up comedy specials for streaming platforms.

name: Tony Hinchcliffe
line: Stand-up comedian, writer, and host of the live comedy podcast Kill Tony. He performs touring stand-up comedy and has written for television roast specials.

name: Dave Chappelle
line: Stand-up comedian and actor known for his sketch series Chappelle's Show and comedy specials. He has received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor, Emmy Awards, and Grammy Awards.

name: Kevin Hart
line: Stand-up comedian and actor known for headlining arena comedy tours and appearing in studio comedy films. He has received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor and People's Choice Awards.

name: Chris Rock
line: Stand-up comedian and actor known for his stand-up specials and work on Saturday Night Live. He has hosted the Academy Awards and received Grammy Awards and Emmy Awards.

name: Conan O'Brien
line: Comedian, television host, and writer known for hosting late-night television talk shows and the podcast Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend. He has received Emmy Awards.

name: Jimmy Kimmel
line: Comedian and television host known for hosting the late-night show Jimmy Kimmel Live!. He has hosted the Academy Awards and the Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Jon Stewart
line: Comedian, writer, and television host known for hosting The Daily Show. He has received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor, Primetime Emmy Awards, and Grammy Awards.

name: Ellen DeGeneres
line: Stand-up comedian and television host known for the sitcom Ellen and the syndicated daytime talk show The Ellen DeGeneres Show. She has received the Presidential Medal of Freedom and Emmy Awards.

name: Pete Davidson
line: Stand-up comedian and actor known for his tenure as a cast member on Saturday Night Live and for co-writing and starring in the film The King of Staten Island.

name: Cody Ko
line: Comedian and internet personality known for comedy commentary videos and co-hosting the podcast Tiny Meat Gang. He also performs stand-up comedy and records music.

name: Jake Shane
line: Comedian and internet personality known for comedic reenactment videos on social media and for hosting the interview podcast Therapuss.

name: Ali Siddiq
line: Stand-up comedian and storyteller known for his comedy specials, including The Domino Effect series, and appearances on Comedy Central's This Is Not Happening.

name: Hans Kim
line: Stand-up comedian known for his recurring appearances as an opening performer on the live podcast Kill Tony and for headlining national comedy club tours.

name: Kyle Kinane
line: Stand-up comedian and voice actor known for his comedy specials, appearances on Comedy Central, and providing voice work as the network's on-air announcer.

name: Sam Tallent
line: Stand-up comedian and writer known for his touring stand-up work, his comedy special The Waiting Room, and his novel Running the Light.

name: Matthew McConaughey
line: Actor known for leading roles in feature films and the television series True Detective. He has received the Academy Award for Best Actor.

name: Dwayne Johnson
line: Actor, producer, and professional wrestler known for leading roles in studio action and comedy films, including the Fast & Furious franchise and Jumanji series.

name: Leonardo DiCaprio
line: Actor and producer known for leading roles in feature films across drama, crime, and historical genres. He has received the Academy Award for Best Actor.

name: Tom Cruise
line: Actor and producer known for performing his own stunt work and starring in feature film franchises, including Mission: Impossible and Top Gun.

name: Brad Pitt
line: Actor and film producer known for leading roles in feature films and producing work through Plan B Entertainment. He has received Academy Awards for acting and producing.

name: Tom Hanks
line: Actor and filmmaker known for leading roles in dramatic and comedic feature films. He has received Academy Awards for Best Actor and the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

name: Keanu Reeves
line: Canadian actor known for starring roles in the "Matrix", "John Wick", and "Bill & Ted" film franchises. He works as a film actor across the action, science fiction, and drama genres.

name: Robert Downey Jr.
line: American actor known for portraying Tony Stark in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Sherlock Holmes, and Lewis Strauss in "Oppenheimer". He is an Academy Award recipient for Best Supporting Actor.

name: Will Smith
line: American actor and producer known for his roles in "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air", "Men in Black", and "King Richard". He is an Academy Award recipient for Best Actor.

name: Adam Sandler
line: American actor and comedian known for starring in comedy and dramatic films, including "Happy Gilmore", "The Wedding Singer", and "Uncut Gems". He received the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor.

name: Denzel Washington
line: American actor and director known for dramatic roles in films such as "Glory", "Malcolm X", and "Training Day". He has received Academy Awards for Best Supporting Actor and Best Actor.

name: Johnny Depp
line: American actor known for portraying Captain Jack Sparrow in the "Pirates of the Caribbean" franchise and collaborating on films directed by Tim Burton. He has received a Golden Globe Award.

name: Ryan Reynolds
line: Canadian-American actor and producer known for portraying the title character in the "Deadpool" film series. He works as an actor in feature films and has a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

name: Timothée Chalamet
line: American actor known for roles in feature films including "Call Me by Your Name", "Dune", and "Wonka". He has received nominations for the Academy Award and Golden Globe Award.

name: Chris Hemsworth
line: Australian actor known for portraying Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in action films such as "Extraction". He works as a film actor in studio productions.

name: George Clooney
line: American actor, director, and producer known for his roles in the television series "ER" and films including "Ocean's Eleven" and "Syriana". He has received Academy Awards for acting and producing.

name: Harrison Ford
line: American actor known for portraying Han Solo in the "Star Wars" franchise and the title character in the "Indiana Jones" series. He has received the AFI Life Achievement Award.

name: Ryan Gosling
line: Canadian actor known for his roles in films such as "The Notebook", "La La Land", and "Barbie". He has received a Golden Globe Award and Academy Award nominations.

name: Tom Holland
line: English actor known for playing Peter Parker in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in films such as "The Impossible" and "Uncharted". He received the BAFTA Rising Star Award.

name: Ben Affleck
line: American actor, director, and screenwriter known for films such as "Good Will Hunting", "The Town", and "Argo". He has received Academy Awards for Best Original Screenplay and Best Picture.

name: Chris Evans
line: American actor known for playing Captain America in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in films such as "Snowpiercer" and "Knives Out". He works as a film actor and Broadway performer.

name: Jim Carrey
line: Canadian-American actor and comedian known for roles in films such as "The Mask", "The Truman Show", and "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind". He has received Golden Globe Awards.

name: Matt Damon
line: American actor, producer, and screenwriter known for starring in the "Bourne" film series, "Good Will Hunting", and "The Martian". He received an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.

name: Pedro Pascal
line: Chilean-born American actor known for starring in television series including "The Mandalorian", "The Last of Us", and "Game of Thrones". He has received Primetime Emmy and Golden Globe Award nominations.

name: Sylvester Stallone
line: American actor, screenwriter, and director known for creating and starring in the "Rocky" and "Rambo" film franchises. He has received a Golden Globe Award and Academy Award nominations.

name: Chris Pratt
line: American actor known for playing Star-Lord in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Owen Grady in the "Jurassic World" franchise. He works as an actor in feature films and television series.

name: Christian Bale
line: Christian Bale is an actor known for portraying Bruce Wayne in the Dark Knight trilogy and Dicky Eklund in The Fighter. He won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in The Fighter.

name: Jack Black
line: Jack Black is an actor and musician known for roles in School of Rock, King Kong, and Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, and for voicing Po in the Kung Fu Panda franchise. He performs in the rock band Tenacious D.

name: Mark Wahlberg
line: Mark Wahlberg is an actor and producer known for his roles in Boogie Nights, The Departed, and The Fighter. He received Academy Award nominations for acting in The Departed and producing The Fighter.

name: Michael B. Jordan
line: Michael B. Jordan is an actor and director known for portraying Adonis Creed in the Creed series and Erik Killmonger in Black Panther. He made his feature film directorial debut with Creed III.

name: Robert Pattinson
line: Robert Pattinson is an actor who played Edward Cullen in The Twilight Saga and the title role in The Batman. His work includes roles in independent dramas such as Good Time and The Lighthouse.

name: Henry Cavill
line: Henry Cavill is an actor who portrayed Superman in the DC Extended Universe, including Man of Steel, and Geralt of Rivia in the television series The Witcher. He also appeared in Mission: Impossible – Fallout.

name: Jason Momoa
line: Jason Momoa is an actor who played Aquaman in the DC Extended Universe and Khal Drogo in the television series Game of Thrones. He also starred in the television series See and the science-fiction film Dune.

name: Nicolas Cage
line: Nicolas Cage is an actor known for leading roles in Leaving Las Vegas, The Rock, and National Treasure. He won an Academy Award for Best Actor for Leaving Las Vegas.

name: Paul Rudd
line: Paul Rudd is an actor known for playing Scott Lang in the Ant-Man and Avengers films, as well as roles in Clueless and Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy. He also appeared in the series Friends.

name: Zac Efron
line: Zac Efron is an actor who starred in the High School Musical films, the comedy Neighbors, and the biographical drama The Iron Claw. He won a Daytime Emmy Award for the documentary series Down to Earth with Zac Efron.

name: Ben Stiller
line: Ben Stiller is an actor, director, and producer known for starring in Meet the Parents, Zoolander, and Night at the Museum. He directed the comedy Tropic Thunder and directed episodes of the drama series Severance.

name: Cillian Murphy
line: Cillian Murphy is an actor known for portraying J. Robert Oppenheimer in Oppenheimer and Thomas Shelby in the television series Peaky Blinders. He won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Oppenheimer.

name: Daniel Craig
line: Daniel Craig is an actor who played James Bond across several films beginning with Casino Royale, and detective Benoit Blanc in the Knives Out series. He has also performed in Broadway theater productions.

name: Daniel Radcliffe
line: Daniel Radcliffe is an actor who portrayed the title character in the Harry Potter film series. He has also performed on stage, winning a Tony Award for the Broadway revival of Merrily We Roll Along.

name: Jake Gyllenhaal
line: Jake Gyllenhaal is an actor known for roles in Donnie Darko, Brokeback Mountain, and Nightcrawler. He received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for Brokeback Mountain and Tony Award nominations for Broadway performances.

name: Steve Carell
line: Steve Carell is an actor and writer known for playing Michael Scott in the comedy series The Office and starring in The 40-Year-Old Virgin. He received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor for Foxcatcher.

name: Andrew Garfield
line: Andrew Garfield is an actor who played Peter Parker in The Amazing Spider-Man films. He won a Tony Award for Angels in America and received Academy Award nominations for Best Actor for Hacksaw Ridge and Tick, Tick... Boom!.

name: Austin Butler
line: Austin Butler is an actor who played Elvis Presley in the biographical film Elvis, winning a BAFTA Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role. He also portrayed Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen in Dune: Part Two.

name: Glen Powell
line: Glen Powell is an actor and screenwriter known for starring in Top Gun: Maverick, Anyone but You, and Twisters. He also co-wrote and starred in the comedy thriller Hit Man.

name: Jacob Elordi
line: Jacob Elordi is an actor known for playing Nate Jacobs in the television series Euphoria, Elvis Presley in Priscilla, and Felix Catton in Saltburn. He received a BAFTA Award nomination for his role in Saltburn.

name: Seth Rogen
line: Seth Rogen is an actor, writer, and filmmaker known for films such as Knocked Up and Superbad and the series Pam & Tommy. He works in comedy and drama, receiving Primetime Emmy Award nominations.

name: Adam Driver
line: Adam Driver is an actor known for playing Kylo Ren in the Star Wars sequel trilogy and starring in Marriage Story and BlacKkKlansman. He works in cinema and theatre, receiving Academy Award and Tony Award nominations.

name: Jeremy Allen White
line: Jeremy Allen White is an actor known for playing Lip Gallagher in Shameless and Carmy Berzatto in The Bear. He works in television and film, winning Primetime Emmy Awards and Golden Globe Awards.

name: Jonah Hill
line: Jonah Hill is an actor, director, and screenwriter known for roles in Superbad, Moneyball, and The Wolf of Wall Street. He works in feature films, receiving Academy Award nominations for Best Supporting Actor.

name: Tom Hiddleston
line: Tom Hiddleston is an actor known for portraying Loki in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in The Night Manager. He works in film, television, and theatre, winning a Golden Globe Award and a Laurence Olivier Award.

name: Anthony Mackie
line: Anthony Mackie is an actor known for portraying Sam Wilson in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and appearing in The Hurt Locker. He works across studio feature films, television series, and Broadway theatre productions.

name: Paul Mescal
line: Paul Mescal is an actor known for the miniseries Normal People and films such as Aftersun and Gladiator II. He works in film and theatre, winning a Laurence Olivier Award and receiving an Academy Award nomination.

name: Sebastian Stan
line: Sebastian Stan is an actor known for portraying Bucky Barnes in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in Pam & Tommy and The Apprentice. He works in film and television, winning a Silver Bear at the Berlin International Film Festival.

name: Aaron Taylor-Johnson
line: Aaron Taylor-Johnson is an actor known for roles in Kick-Ass, Nocturnal Animals, Tenet, and Kraven the Hunter. He works in studio feature films, winning a Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor.

name: Alexander Skarsgård
line: Alexander Skarsgård is an actor known for television roles in True Blood, Big Little Lies, and Succession, as well as films like The Northman. He works in film and television, winning a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award.

name: Barry Keoghan
line: Barry Keoghan is an actor known for roles in Dunkirk, The Banshees of Inisherin, and Saltburn. He works in international and independent feature films, winning a BAFTA Award and receiving an Academy Award nomination.

name: David Corenswet
line: David Corenswet is an actor known for starring in television series such as The Politician and Hollywood, and playing Clark Kent in Superman. He works in studio feature films and television productions.

name: Joe Keery
line: Joe Keery is an actor known for playing Steve Harrington in the series Stranger Things and appearing in the film Free Guy. He works in television, film, and theatre, winning a Screen Actors Guild Award for ensemble performance.

name: Michael Cera
line: Michael Cera is an actor known for the television series Arrested Development and films including Superbad, Juno, and Scott Pilgrim vs. the World. He works across film, television, and Broadway theatre, receiving a Tony Award nomination.

name: Nicholas Hoult
line: Nicholas Hoult is an actor known for roles in the X-Men film series, Mad Max: Fury Road, and the series The Great. He works in feature films and television, receiving Primetime Emmy Award nominations.

name: Walton Goggins
line: Walton Goggins is an actor known for television roles in The Shield, Justified, The Righteous Gemstones, and Fallout. He works in television and feature films, receiving Primetime Emmy Award nominations.

name: Adam Scott
line: Adam Scott is an actor and producer known for portraying Ben Wyatt in Parks and Recreation and Mark Scout in Severance. He works in television and film, receiving Primetime Emmy Award nominations for acting and producing.

name: Chiwetel Ejiofor
line: Chiwetel Ejiofor is an actor and filmmaker known for starring in 12 Years a Slave and appearing in Doctor Strange. He works in film, television, and theatre, winning a BAFTA Award and receiving an Academy Award nomination.

name: Harris Dickinson
line: Harris Dickinson is an actor and filmmaker known for roles in Beach Rats, Triangle of Sadness, and The Iron Claw. He works in independent and studio films, receiving a BAFTA Rising Star Award nomination.

name: Josh O'Connor
line: Josh O'Connor is an actor known for portraying Prince Charles in the series The Crown and starring in God's Own Country and Challengers. He works in film and television, winning a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award.

name: Miles Caton
line: Miles Caton is an American actor and musician known for portraying Sammie Moore in Ryan Coogler's film Sinners. He works in feature films and received the Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Young Performer.

name: Patrick Schwarzenegger
line: Patrick Schwarzenegger is an American actor who works in television and feature films. He is known for his roles in the drama series The Staircase, the superhero series Gen V, and the film Midnight Sun.

name: Will Poulter
line: Will Poulter is an English actor working in studio films and television. He is known for roles in The Maze Runner, The Revenant, and Dopesick, and he is a recipient of the BAFTA Rising Star Award.

name: Dominic Sessa
line: Dominic Sessa is an American actor working in film. Known for his screen debut as Angus Tully in Alexander Payne's comedy-drama The Holdovers, he received the Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Young Performer and a BAFTA nomination.

name: Joseph Zada
line: Joseph Zada is an Australian actor working in international television and film. He is known for starring in the series We Were Liars and was cast as Haymitch Abernathy in the feature film The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.

name: Selena Gomez
line: Selena Gomez is an American actress and producer working in television and film. She stars in the mystery series Only Murders in the Building and received the Best Actress Award at the Cannes Film Festival for Emilia Pérez.

name: Scarlett Johansson
line: Scarlett Johansson is an American actress working in studio and independent films. Known for portraying Natasha Romanoff in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and starring in Marriage Story, she is a recipient of a BAFTA Award and a Tony Award.

name: Zendaya
line: Zendaya is an American actress working in television and film. Known for the drama series Euphoria and the films Dune and Challengers, she has received Primetime Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award for her performances.

name: Julia Roberts
line: Julia Roberts is an American actress who works in feature films. Known for starring in Pretty Woman and Erin Brockovich, she is a recipient of an Academy Award for Best Actress, a BAFTA Award, and Golden Globe Awards.

name: Margot Robbie
line: Margot Robbie is an Australian actress and producer working in international cinema. She is known for leading roles in The Wolf of Wall Street, I, Tonya, and Barbie, earning nominations for Academy Awards and BAFTA Awards.

name: Meryl Streep
line: Meryl Streep is an American actress working across film, television, and theatre. Known for roles in Sophie's Choice, The Devil Wears Prada, and The Iron Lady, she has received Academy Awards, Emmy Awards, and Golden Globe Awards.

name: Anne Hathaway
line: Anne Hathaway is an American actress working in studio and independent films. Known for The Devil Wears Prada and Les Misérables, she is a recipient of an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress and a BAFTA Award.

name: Jennifer Lawrence
line: Jennifer Lawrence is an American actress working in feature films. Known for The Hunger Games franchise and Silver Linings Playbook, she is a recipient of an Academy Award for Best Actress and a BAFTA Award.

name: Sydney Sweeney
line: Sydney Sweeney is an American actress and producer working in television and film. She is known for her roles in the drama series Euphoria and The White Lotus, as well as the films Reality and Anyone But You.

name: Emma Stone
line: Emma Stone is an American actress working in feature films. Known for starring in La La Land, The Favourite, and Poor Things, she is a recipient of Academy Awards for Best Actress and BAFTA Awards.

name: Emma Watson
line: Emma Watson is an English actress working in international cinema. She is known for portraying Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films and starring in The Perks of Being a Wallflower, Beauty and the Beast, and Little Women.

name: Nicole Kidman
line: Nicole Kidman is an Australian and American actress and producer working in film and television. Known for The Hours, Moulin Rouge!, and Big Little Lies, she is a recipient of an Academy Award for Best Actress and Primetime Emmy Awards.

name: Sandra Bullock
line: Sandra Bullock is an American actress and producer working in feature films. Known for starring in Speed, Miss Congeniality, and The Blind Side, she is a recipient of an Academy Award for Best Actress and a Golden Globe Award.

name: Gal Gadot
line: Gal Gadot is an Israeli actress working in international feature films. She is known for portraying Diana Prince in the DC Extended Universe, including Wonder Woman, and for her role as Gisele Yashar in the Fast & Furious film series.

name: Jenna Ortega
line: Jenna Ortega is an American actress working in television and film. She is known for playing Wednesday Addams in the series Wednesday and starring in the Scream film series, earning Primetime Emmy Award and Golden Globe Award nominations.

name: Millie Bobby Brown
line: Millie Bobby Brown is a British actress known for starring as Eleven in the series Stranger Things and playing the title role in Enola Holmes. Her television work has earned her Primetime Emmy Award nominations.

name: Blake Lively
line: Blake Lively is an American actress known for starring as Serena van der Woodsen in the television series Gossip Girl. She works as a lead actress in studio films, including The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants and A Simple Favor.

name: Demi Moore
line: Demi Moore is an American film actress known for starring in films such as Ghost and A Few Good Men. She works in studio and independent cinema and has earned Golden Globe Award nominations.

name: Florence Pugh
line: Florence Pugh is an English actress known for her roles in Midsommar, Little Women, and Oppenheimer. She works in studio franchises and independent cinema, earning an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress.

name: Ana de Armas
line: Ana de Armas is a Cuban and Spanish actress known for starring in Blade Runner 2049, Knives Out, and Blonde. Her portrayal of Marilyn Monroe in Blonde earned her an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress.

name: Zoe Saldaña
line: Zoe Saldaña is an American actress known for starring roles in the Avatar, Guardians of the Galaxy, and Star Trek film franchises. She also shared the Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival for Emilia Pérez.

name: Kristen Stewart
line: Kristen Stewart is an American actress known for starring in The Twilight Saga and independent films. She won a César Award for Clouds of Sils Maria and earned an Academy Award nomination for Spencer.

name: Elizabeth Olsen
line: Elizabeth Olsen is an American actress known for playing Wanda Maximoff in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the miniseries WandaVision. Her television work has earned her Primetime Emmy and Golden Globe Award nominations.

name: Zoë Kravitz
line: Zoë Kravitz is an American actress and filmmaker known for her roles in Big Little Lies and as Catwoman in The Batman. She also directed the feature film Blink Twice.

name: Elle Fanning
line: Elle Fanning is an American actress known for roles in films such as Super 8 and Maleficent. Her portrayal of Catherine the Great in the series The Great earned her a Primetime Emmy Award nomination.

name: Sadie Sink
line: Sadie Sink is an American actress known for playing Max Mayfield in the series Stranger Things. She has also performed on Broadway and starred in the drama film The Whale, receiving a Critics' Choice Movie Award nomination.

name: Margaret Qualley
line: Margaret Qualley is an American actress known for her roles in the film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood and the miniseries Maid. Her television performances have earned her Primetime Emmy Award nominations.

name: Ayo Edebiri
line: Ayo Edebiri is an American actress, comedian, and writer known for starring as Sydney Adamu in the series The Bear. She has won a Primetime Emmy Award and a Golden Globe Award for her performance.

name: Bella Ramsey
line: Bella Ramsey is an English actor known for roles in Game of Thrones and starring as Ellie in The Last of Us. That performance earned nominations for Primetime Emmy and Golden Globe Awards.

name: Rachel Zegler

name: Christopher Nolan
